<thought>To find a single-step retrosynthetic transformation that corresponds to the reverse of a carbonyl‑ene reaction, I will search the template catalog for templates that break an aliphatic hydroxyl group and form a ketone and a C‑C double bond. These functional‑group specifications match the allowed names in the database.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CC[C@@]1(O)C(F)(F)F",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
